purpose: Test whether the public stats endpoint returns stable, season-scoped responses for known weekly-round scopes. Read-only GET requests only.

findings.interpretation: A repeated cross-season boxscore cluster in a live season_id=5 response is evidence the returned table is contaminated or mis-scoped at source/query level; explicit season_id is present, and minimal/full request parity can rule out omitted team/position/sort filters as the cause. This test cannot identify the backend implementation defect.

safeguards: Isolated candidates are not automatically quarantined
